description: scATAC-seq Level 2 data - Aligned data and alignment QC metrics

AVERAGE_INSERT_SIZE.description: Average insert size collected. Required when LIBRARY_LAYOUT is Paired-end.

CHIMERIC_READ_PAIRS.description: Number of chimerically mapped read-pairs. Sanity check - must be <= TOTAL_READ_PAIRS (Level 1).

CONTAMINATION.description: Fraction of reads coming from cross-sample contamination collected from GATK4.

CONTAMINATION_ERROR.description: Estimation error of cross-sample contamination collected from GATK4.

DUPLICATE_READ_PAIRS.description: Number of duplicate read-pairs. Sanity check - must be <= TOTAL_READ_PAIRS (Level 1).

FILENAME.description: Name of the file. Must end with an extension matching the FILE_FORMAT (.bam for bam; .cram for cram)

FILE_FORMAT.description: Format of the aligned file (bam or cram)

GENOME_ANNOTATION_URL.description: URL to genome or transcriptome annotation

GENOMIC_REFERENCE.description: Genomic or transcriptomic reference assembly used for alignment. If your genome reference is not among the valid values, please contact your data liaison.
GENOMIC_REFERENCE.title: GenomicReferenceEnum

GENOMIC_REFERENCE_URL.description: URL to genomic or transcriptomic reference

HTAN_PARENT_ID.description: HTAN Parent ID(s) - Foreign key(s) to parent entity (B for Biospecimen, D for data file). One or more IDs; for aggregated files provide multiple. Each ID must have B or D suffix. Supports HTA200-229 for phase 2.

LIBRARY_PREPARATION_DAYS_FROM_INDEX.description: Number of days between when the sample for assay was received in the lab and the libraries were prepared for sequencing. If not applicable please enter 'Not Applicable')

LOW_MAP_Q.description: Number of read-pairs with <30 mapq on at least one end

MEAN_COVERAGE.description: Mean coverage for whole genome sequencing, or mean target coverage for whole exome and targeted sequencing

MEDIAN_FRAGMENTS_PER_CELL.description: Median number of sequencing fragments detected per cell across all cells in the dataset.

MEDIAN_GENES_PER_CELL.description: Median number of genes with detected gene expression per cell across all cells in the dataset. Optional - typically only available for multiome; regular scATAC-seq does not report it (per review, ykatariy).

MEDIAN_PASSING_READS_PERCENTAGE.description: Non-PCR duplicate nuclear genomic sequence reads not aligning to unanchored contigs out of total reads assigned to the nucleus barcode

MITOCHONDRIAL_READ_PAIRS.description: Number of read-pairs mapping to mitochondria and non-nuclear contigs. Optional - sparsely reported for snATAC submissions (per review, ykatariy).

NUMBER_OF_CELLS.description: Total number of cells or nuclei retained in the dataset after filtering.

PAIRS_ON_DIFF_CHR.description: Pairs on different chromosomes collected from samtools.

PASSED_FILTERS.description: Number of non-duplicate, usable read-pairs (fragments) that aligned to the reference genome.

PROPORTION_BASE_MISMATCH.description: Proportion of mismatched bases collected from samtools.

PROPORTION_COVERAGE_10X.description: Proportion of all reference bases for whole genome sequencing, or targeted bases for whole exome and targeted sequencing, that achieves 10X or greater coverage from Picard Tools.

PROPORTION_COVERAGE_30X.description: Proportion of all reference bases for whole genome sequencing, or targeted bases for whole exome and targeted sequencing, that achieves 30X or greater coverage from Picard Tools.

PROPORTION_MITOCHONDRIAL_READS.description: Proportion of reads mapping to mitochondria

PROPORTION_READS_DUPLICATED.description: Proportion of duplicated reads collected from samtools.

PROPORTION_READS_MAPPED.description: Proportion of mapped reads collected from samtools.

PROPORTION_TARGETS_NO_MATCH.description: Proportion of targets that did not reach 1X coverage over any base from Picard Tools.

SHORT_READS.description: Number of reads that were too short

THRESHOLD_FOR_MINIMUM_PASSING_READS.description: Minimum number of passing reads used as the threshold for calling a barcode a cell.

TOTAL_UNIQUELY_MAPPED.description: Number of reads that map to genome.

TOTAL_UNMAPPED_READS.description: Number of reads that did not map to genome

UNMAPPED_READ_PAIRS.description: Number of read-pairs with at least one end not mapped. Sanity check - must be <= TOTAL_READ_PAIRS (Level 1).

WORKFLOW_LINK.description: Link to workflow or command. DockStore.org recommended

WORKFLOW_VERSION.description: Major version of the workflow, or 'Not applicable' when no workflow version applies.
